record_grain: one monthly permit audit row; records are permits issued in report month

interpretation.light_industrial: No standalone explicit-text matches in the current taxonomy; zero matches do not establish no activity.
interpretation.residential: Retained in coverage; multi-unit residential is a separate overlapping focus category.
interpretation.current_status: Monthly audit rows show permit issuance only; they do not establish open, active, under-construction, or completed status.
interpretation.value_and_gfa: Nominal source-reported permit values and reported building GFA; not realized investment or current project value.

known_source_reconciliation.open_issue: June 2025 has 468 numbered audit rows while its aggregate Summary Report states 469 permits.
